notes.title: V1.4.0 版本更新（V1.4.0 version update）
notes.content:
1、	修复吸收热能可能出现错误数据。
2、	调整热能与电能的下降比例，防止频繁补充基础元素，导致的疲劳感。
3、	其他机械兽的名称永远朝向你，便于识别身份。
4、	修复退化时，可能导致护甲值继续增加的情况。
5、	修正脚部、战斗音效，提升游玩体验。
6、	提升进化节奏，提升游戏趣味体验。
7、	上线新款机械兽：利爪兽
8、	近期会为每款机械兽设计独特的种族技能，最近几天上线。

1. Repairing the absorption of heat energy may result in incorrect data.
2. Adjust the decrease ratio between thermal and electrical energy to prevent fatigue caused by frequent supplementation of basic elements.
3. The names of other mechanical beasts always face you for easy identification.
4. When repairing degradation, it may cause the armor value to continue to increase.
5. Fix feet, combat sound effects, and enhance gaming experience.
6. Enhance the pace of evolution and enhance the fun experience of the game.
7. New mechanical beast launched: Claw Beast
8. We will design unique race skills for each mechanical beast in the near future, and it will be launched in the next few days.

notes.title: V1.3版本更新（V1.3version patch）
notes.content:
为了提供更优质的网络服务，我们更新的网络服务组件，用于更多的玩家登录游戏。
并且本次更新大幅度降低了进化难度，来加快游戏的节奏，让玩家体验进化与退化的乐趣。
近期，网络服务属于测试阶段，可能存在瑕疵，最近几天会不断优化更新，还请谅解。

In order to provide better network services, we have updated our network service components for more players to log in to the game.

And this update significantly reduces the difficulty of evolution, accelerating the pace of the game and allowing players to experience the fun of evolution and degradation.

Recently, network services are in the testing phase and may have flaws. We will continue to optimize and update them in the next few days. Please understand.

tags.balance_change: 并且本次更新大幅度降低了进化难度，来加快游戏的节奏，让玩家体验进化与退化的乐趣。

notes.title: V1.2 Version Update Summary
notes.content:
1. Fixed abnormal movement of the mechanical beast when retreating.
2. After fixing the English settings on the menu bar, some English displays may not be complete.
3. When repairing evolution, the evolution action is abnormal.
4. Fix the discrepancy between the displayed values in the menu bar and the actual values.
5. Repairing AI will run above the current river.
6. Fix the decimal error in the display of electrical energy values.
7. Optimize the display effect and range of the current river.
8. Optimizing abnormal running movements after eating.
9. Record the offline location. After logging in again, the location remains unchanged.
10. Change to the default locking perspective when packing backpacks, and add the use of the left alt button to unlock.
11. Upgrade evolutionary numerical algorithms to make evolution, mutation, and distortion more accurate.
12. Add one click running function.
13. When AI attacks players, increase the attack sound effect.
14. Add volume control to the menu bar.
15. Add mouse sensitivity control to the menu bar.
16. Repairing genetic growth errors during eating.
17. Fix the issue of being unable to run due to an electrical bug.
18. Repairing AI new entry routes, making it more intelligent.
19. Repair degraded functionality.
20. Increase the display of maximum armor limit.
21. Add a one button return to ground function to avoid being unable to operate due to accidental falling into the ground.
22. Fix the issue of appearance not displaying or displaying abnormalities when multiple mechanical beasts are online simultaneously.

notes.title: V 1.1 Version Update Announcement
notes.content:
V 1.1 Version Update Announcement

Thank you for your comments. We will keep updating.

This round of updates includes:

1. Fix the problem that you may not be able to run when eating in the current river.

2. Repairing and killing low alloy mechanical animals will cause problems with high alloy mechanical animal parts.

3. Fix the problem of no eating movement when occasionally eating.

4. Fix the problem that only when you go deep into the current river can you eat electric energy.

5. Fixed the problem of low resolution of some trees in the scene.

6. Fix the problem that may cause a large increase in heat energy when eating.

7. Fixed the problem that other players' mechanical beasts could not be displayed normally in the smoke.

8. Fixed the problem that in some cases, the mechanical beasts among players could not attack each other effectively.

9. After death, the attack judgment is abnormal. After logging in again, the problem returns to normal and will not occur again after repair.

10. Fixed an accidental problem where the cursor was not displayed when the nickname was re entered after death.
